Michelin Level Indeed
Apr 2025 • Couples
My spouse and I had the pleasure of dining around the world, and Quince/Madam Kew belongs in the top tier.

We walked in without a reservation to a full main dining room, but the staff had some room upstairs. Initially, we thought this would be “less than”, but the decor was that of an upscale, modern lounge with a great vibe.

Then came the menu… a Tomahawk in Ho Chi Minh City… YES!!!! We started with oysters which were presented and served uniquely and beautifully, and then dug into our Tommy with sides of some of the best “Not so Mashed Potatoes” and roasted cauliflower with whipped cheese.

You could tell there was a French influence throughout the service, and we were thrilled to see it.

The flavour, presentation, and service were excellent throughout the night. We enjoyed every bite. Probably too many bites, ha.

I suppose the Michelin Guide was right to feature this restaurant, but maybe they will get a star before too long.

Feb 2023 • Couples
WOW, what a great find in Ho Chi Minh city. My partner and I visited here this week and we both agree that it has to be one of thes best culinary experiences we have ever had. From the moment we arrived and all throughout the evening the service was exceptional, the wait staff could not have been more cheery and helpful with every course and drinks pour. We went all out and ordered the Nori Taco/Tortellini with bone marrow, BBQ Octopus and just had to the Fois Gras duck pate as an extra. The level of detail in all dishes was on point, beautifully constructed, generous servings, packed full of flavours, what a perfect star, all paired with a lovely light Rose. For the main course we could not go past the 200g Wagyu steak and aged Duck, both being juicy and tender accompanied with sides of truffle potatoes and broccolis, what a flavour explosion. With what little room I had left I was tempted by the honeycomb desert, and glad I weakened. The entire evening was a flavour sensation which just kept changing and surprising with each dish. Our manager, Kim, was so gracious and attentive through our stay, I have to say the energy and enthusiasm she has with all guests and staff is amazing. The open kitchen allows full view of the very busy kitchen with back of house staff and Chefs performing their magic. You have to try Quince for the great memories that will stay with you well past the time you spend in Saigon, loved it.

Truly the best fine dining experience in VN.
Sep 2020
I booked a quiet table for two on their facebook page and received a confirmation and a question about any special requests. I mentioned a food allergy, but said we'd confirm with our server. The night of our dinner, the maitre'd confirmed with us that none of the current dishes on the menu contained zucchini, so we could rest assured there'd be no problem. The menu is a la carte, but she asked about our preferences and helped us to navigate the menu and create a progression of courses that would complement each other, within reason because I had a few must-try dishes. Service was highly attentive without being intrusive and when I had a question about an ingredient I had never heard of, her answer was informative and delivered warmly without an ounce of condescension. In fact, she seemed quite pleased to be introducing me to something new. Other fine dining establishments in HCMC that are part of a fine-dining group of restaurants treated me rather poorly when I asked a question about a dish. Everything about our meal was homey and comfortable but elevated as you can see from the photos. There were some things I would change, but I think those are more a matter of personal taste and unlike those other fine dining restaurants where I spent a comparable amount of money, I left completely satisfied and like I had received well-cooked appropriate portions for the money. It was definitely a treat at about $200USD for everything pictured, but well worth it.
